أستلب (form VIII)
# أَسْتَلِبُ (ʔastalibu) /ʔas.ta.li.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# أُسْتَلَبُ (ʔustalabu) /ʔus.ta.la.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# أَسْتَلِبَ (ʔastaliba) /ʔas.ta.li.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَلَبَ (istalaba)
# أُسْتَلَبَ (ʔustalaba) /ʔus.ta.la
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
